author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Synergy Test 1: 1500 HVGs + No PBVE-lite
abstract: Following reviewer feedback on Archive #58, this experiment tests if the performance benefit of using 1500 HVGs persists when the PBVE-lite (Ridge Regression) correction step is removed from the SOTA pipeline. This will help determine if the synergy is between the 1500 HVG set and the PBVE-lite component specifically.
